title: Tenant-state checkpoint migration harness for VPC runtime upgrades
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build an automated, tenant-scoped migration harness that upgrades the private (VPC) data-plane runtime without global drains, provides fast rollback using point-in-time state checkpoints, and detects terraform drift pre-apply. This harness must work across Dedicated and Private modes and integrate with our existing orchestration and observability hooks.

Scope:
- Terraform preflight drift detection and safe plan gating
- Tenant-scoped state checkpoint snapshots (KV + ephemeral caches)
- Progressive traffic slices with health-gating (percentage and time-window)
- Deterministic automated rollback using snapshot restore + traffic steerback
- Clear runbook and manual overrides for emergency aborts

Why this work: Current VPC rollouts either require heavy tenant drains or rely on broad blue/green switches that are costly for customers. A checkpoint-based migration reduces application-visible downtime and gives faster, reliable rollback without a full tenant re-provision.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform preflight stage blocks plan if resource drift > configurable threshold and posts clear remediation steps to console
Upgrade can be executed for an individual tenant slice (>=1% of tenants) with no error-rate regression beyond baseline + 1% within kinesis window
KV cache snapshotting completes within SLO (default 45s) for medium-sized tenants and can be restored to an older runtime within defined maintenance window
Automated rollback triggers when 3 consecutive health probes fail OR sustained 50% increase in 95th p90 latency for 2 minutes
Post-rollback state reconciliation finishes and tenant returns to pre-upgrade traffic split within 5 minutes without manual intervention
All operations are logged with run id, checkpoint id, and Terraform plan id and visible in Console rollout UI
rollout_plan: Preflight: terraform plan + drift check against last-known state; abort on drift threshold; produce plan-id
Snapshot: create tenant checkpoint (KV snapshot + minimal metadata); store checkpoint id in S3 with immutable retention for 24h
Canary: route 1% traffic slice to runtime build under test for 10 minutes; run synthetic probes and golden prompt evals
Progressive: increase slices 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with health gating (each stage requires 5m of stable metrics)
Finalize: mark checkpoint as superseded, expire temporary snapshots, emit rollout-complete event to audit logs
rollback_playbook: Automatic: if health gate fails, instantly throttle new connections to the upgraded pool and steer new traffic back to baseline pool via routing controller
Automatic: trigger checkpoint restore job (checkpoint id from rollout context) which performs a KV reconcile and warms local caches
Fallback: if checkpoint restore fails, run fallback script to patch routing to standby nodes and mark tenant quarantined for manual intervention
Manual steps: how to abort terraform apply, pin tenant to previous runtime image, and trigger a manual restore with prescribed safety checks
Post-rollback verification: run diagnostic suite and compare key metrics vs pre-upgrade baseline; run smoke indirects and a golden prompt set
test_plan: Unit tests: terraform module drift-detector logic and plan parser
Integration: end-to-end upgrade simulation in staging with synthetic tenants of varying sizes, including simulated network flaps
Chaos: introduce node failures and KV snapshot corruption scenarios to ensure rollback paths execute cleanly
Performance: ensure checkpoint create/restore latency under target for 95% of tenants in staging
Security: validate checkpoint storage encryption (KMS), access controls and audit events
implementation_notes: Terraform: add a new module 'vpc_rollout_harness' that returns plan-id and drift-score; implement preflight hooks in pipeline
Checkpoint store: S3 bucket with per-tenant prefix + versioned objects; retention lifecycle 7 days for non-critical tenants, configurable per-contract
RPC: extend existing runtime agent with /checkpoint/create, /checkpoint/restore, /checkpoint/status endpoints
Routing: reuse canary-routing-controller that supports percentage routing at tenant granularity; add explicit pin API for rollback
Observability: add rollout_id and checkpoint_id tags to all traces and logs; dashboard panel for 'upgrade health by tenant'
Security: checkpoint encryption keys must be customer-specific KMS; include access policy template for Private installs
